# 2 Baruch Chapter 23 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** And I answered and said: O Lord my Lord, I have spoken before you already what I knew, and I have learned what I did not know.

**2** For you have said previously that you know the number of those who are born — how many there shall be, how many have already come, and how many are yet to come.

**3** But this one thing I say before you: just as those who are in the womb do not know the hour of their coming forth, and those who return to the dust do not know the hour of their departure —

**4** So also human beings do not know the hour of your visitation.

**5** And I said to him: But are there indeed souls that are reserved in the treasury, so that when the number is complete they may come forth?

**6** And he answered and said to me: All the souls that are now alive, and those that have already departed, and those that are yet to be born — behold, they are all with him.

**7** For the Most High has not made the world except for the sake of many; but the coming one will not come until the number that has been decreed is complete.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. Ch. 23 develops the theology of the heavenly treasury of souls — a fixed, predetermined number that must be reached before the end arrives. The womb/birth analogy illuminates human ignorance of divine timing.*
